summary: Completed backend + frontend verification for six-month SKU Performance enhancements. Six-month API math/filter contracts, legacy SKU endpoint regression, UI filters/tiles/table/popup behavior, desktop-mobile overflow, and production build were validated.
action_items: Optional hardening: reduce expected pre-login /api/auth/me 401 noise on Login page if clean-console policy is strict.
Optional maintainability: split very large file /app/frontend/src/layouts/DashboardLayout.js (>700 lines).
critical_code_review_comments: Maintainability risk: /app/frontend/src/layouts/DashboardLayout.js is oversized (~879 lines), above the 700-line guideline.
Test hygiene risk in legacy tests: some older backend tests still use hardcoded REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fallback values; keep env-only base URL strategy for future additions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public URL from frontend/.env. Backend pytest file (9 tests) passed including six-month month-window checks, per-SKU/account reconciliations, summary MoM reconciliation, distributor/unassigned filters, reset-equivalent baseline, legacy endpoint contract, and crate fallback helper logic. Frontend desktop/mobile validation passed: six month headers, six tiles, distributor filter present, no city/territory/state/time selector, account popup six-month subtitle and distributor tags, account reset on distributor change, no document overflow (desktop docW=1920; mobile docW=390; table internal horizontal scroll works). Production build succeeded with non-blocking warnings.
rca of the issue: No feature regression detected in tested scope. Observed console 401s on login before authentication appear to be pre-auth auth-check behavior rather than a SKU-performance defect.
